acceptanceScope: Prototype acceptance for the AI Builder Cup 2026 demonstration with supervisor approval of every job. Not certification for autonomous factory control.

sourceData.provenance: Modelled production history generated by generator.ts (seed 20261010) from the plant's 117-item master (prepagent.items), real paper costs and operator-described defect rules; loaded 11 Oct 2026. Not recorded plant measurements.
sourceData.fingerprintMethod: BIT_XOR(FARM_FINGERPRINT(TO_JSON_STRING(row))) over all columns except scrap_cost (re-priced on 13 Oct; it is not a feature or label)
sourceData.post-training changes: scrap_cost re-priced (Rs 45 → Rs 53.30/kg) on 13 Oct; scrap_cost is not used by the models.

holdoutIntegrity.evidence: Training SQL filter run_date < DATE '2026-09-01' (SQL hash per model) and training-window max date 2026-08-31
holdoutIntegrity.notes: Default boosted-tree options; no tuning. Thresholds were set on 11–14 Oct before the holdout evaluation ran on 16 Oct.

thresholdHistory: Strength (0.45) and crack (0.30) bars were set from a local pre-training estimate on the same data, before BigQuery training; both models cleared them narrowly. Warp, delam and print use 0.60.

ownerReview.plausible: Yes. Humidity, gum amount, top-liner GSM (the printing-grade top liner is heavier than the inner liner, a known cause of bending), drying time and ink colours (a proxy for printed boxes with that heavier top liner) are the expected drivers of bending.
ownerReview.anomalies: None material. width_mm and ink_coverage_pct are low-gain size and print proxies.
ownerReview.limits: Holdout R² 0.40 vs 0.61 internally: weaker on an unseen monsoon month, where bending rates and their spread are higher.

warp.statusBasis: Internal R² meets the D4 prototype threshold; identity, version, training job and data window are verified; holdout and limitations are disclosed. Internal-split sample count is not recoverable (see evaluationCountStatus).

ownerReview.plausible: Partly. Humidity, paper type (recycled is weaker), pasting pressure (crushed flutes) and BF are expected. Box height, which drives the BF requirement, is not in the top 8.
ownerReview.anomalies: quantity and shift carry small gain: likely noise fitting.
ownerReview.limits: Weak model (internal R² 0.47, holdout 0.30). Strength is a small share of scrap (about 1%).

ownerReview.plausible: Yes. Ink colours, coverage and flute profile dominate, as expected for print defects; ply and width act as board-stiffness proxies.
ownerReview.anomalies: customer_id has gain 8.3 over only 3 splits: noise or an item proxy, with no causal meaning. gum_viscosity_sec is an indirect effect through bending.
ownerReview.limits: Holdout R² 0.61: holds up on the unseen month.

ownerReview.plausible: Partly. Humidity dominates (cracks occur in dry conditions), as expected. Die-cut style and paper moisture effects are not separately visible.
ownerReview.anomalies: Low-gain features after humidity (ink coverage, roll temperature, supplier, shift) are noise.
ownerReview.limits: Holdout R² −0.01: no predictive skill within a monsoon month, where humidity is uniformly high and crack rates barely vary. Shown as low confidence in monsoon; crack is about 0.7 percentage points of scrap.
